name: joulo
description: Read your home EV charging sessions, ERE earnings and electricity prices from Joulo, and find public chargers in the Netherlands.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Joulo account to see your EV charging at home and find public charging in the Netherlands. See your charging stations and whether they count for ERE (Emissiereductie-eenheden), your sessions, energy totals and charts over time. See per year and quarter what is expected, reserved, traded, payable and paid. Check the electricity price per hour, the cheapest time to charge, what charging cost you and what a kilometre costs. Find public chargers near a place or along a route, with the price of a session and how many are free, on a map. Ask for a mail when a laadpunt at a full location comes free, and stop it again. That alert is the only thing the plugin can change. It cannot start or stop charging, change your account, delete data, sell ERE's or start a payment. Euro values for sessions and the indicative ERE price are estimates, not guaranteed payouts. A Joulo account and an OAuth connection are required.
defaultPrompt: Which of my charging stations count for ERE, and is one charging now?
When is electricity cheapest tonight to charge my car?
Where can I fast-charge on the way from Utrecht to Groningen?

positive.description: Charger inventory and live state. Setup: authenticated dedicated sample account containing one charger. Compare all returned inventory, status and MID fields with the actual API response. A running session is optional; assert only the returned state.
positive.prompt: Show my charging stations, their status, and which ones count for ERE. Is any of them charging now?
positive.expected_behavior: Call list_chargers with no inputs. List the returned station nicknames or ids, status and MID eligibility. Describe a running session only when the response holds one. Do not claim that a station without MID eligibility counts for ERE.

positive.description: Annual position and quarter breakdown. Setup: dedicated sample account containing a 2026 ERE position. Compare each returned category and quarter with the actual response. Zero or unavailable values are valid; do not fabricate nonzero amounts.
positive.prompt: For 2026, how much of my ERE is expected, reserved, traded, payable and already paid? Break it down by quarter.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_ere_position with year=2026. Report each returned expected, reserved, traded, payable and paid position and its quarterly breakdown with the returned units and currency. Keep the categories apart and do not add overlapping stages into one total. Do not describe expected or reserved amounts as paid.

positive.description: Price curve with the widget. Setup: dedicated demo account. Prices for today exist after the daily publication; the returned slots are the oracle. A host with MCP Apps or Apps SDK support shows the price curve widget.
positive.prompt: Show today's electricity price per hour and tell me the cheapest time to charge.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_price_curve for today. Show the returned prices in euro per kWh incl. VAT and name the cheapest slot from summary. Read contract.type: on a fixed contract say that the hour does not change what the user pays; on unknown, ask. Never invent prices for slots that are not in the response.

positive.description: Public chargers near a place, with an optional mail alert. Setup: any authenticated account. The returned locations are the oracle; free counts change every minute. A host with widget support shows the charger map.
positive.prompt: Where can I charge near Utrecht Centraal, and what does a session cost there? If the nearest one is full, mail me when a laadpunt comes free.
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_public_chargers with place set to Utrecht Centraal. Report the nearest returned locations with operator, distance, free laadpunten and reference_price. When a price has status unknown, say it is unknown, never that charging is free. Only when the nearest location has no free laadpunt, confirm with the user and then call watch_public_charger with its party_id and location_id. Report expires_at and that the mail goes to the address of the Joulo account. Never promise that a laadpunt will be free on arrival.

positive.description: Charging costs and cost per kilometre. Setup: dedicated demo account with sessions in the previous calendar month. The returned totals are the oracle; priced_share below 1 makes the costs a lower bound.
positive.prompt: What did charging at home cost me last month, and what does a kilometre cost me?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_charging_costs for the previous calendar month. Quote the returned totals and the per_km figure; do not add up sessions or compute a price per kilometre yourself. Say that the consumption behind per_km is an assumption and that public charging is not included. When priced_share is below 1, say the costs are a lower bound.

negative.description: Unsupported charger control. Explain that the plugin reads data and can set mail alerts for public chargers, but cannot start or stop charging. Do not invoke any tool to perform control or claim the charger was stopped.
negative.prompt: Stop charging on all my chargers now.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. Explain that the plugin cannot delete charging sessions or account data; direct the user to Joulo support or account channels without claiming deletion. Do not invoke any tool as a deletion action.
negative.prompt: Delete my entire charging history from Joulo.

negative.description: Unsupported ERE sale and payout. Explain that the plugin can show an ERE position but cannot sell ERE's or start a bank payment. Do not invoke a read tool as fulfillment or claim a transaction occurred.
negative.prompt: Sell all my ERE's and pay the proceeds into my bank account now.

review.commerce_description: Display of personal EV charging data, ERE earnings and public charging prices, plus mail alerts for a free public laadpunt. No purchases, ERE sales, payment initiation or checkout flow are supported.

publication.release_notes: Covers the server's new tools. Public charging: chargers on a map, the price of a session, fast chargers along a route and a mail when a laadpunt comes free. Also electricity price history and forecast, solar and weather data, grid operator costs, charts, the cost per kilometre and the Joulo blog. The descriptions now say that alerts are the one thing the plugin can change.
